_comment: Session-plane socket ACL (ADR-2153). Loaded by services/agentbox-sessions from AGENTBOX_SESSIONS_ACL.
Authorisation is the caller's uid from SO_PEERCRED, never the socket mode (0660 in group ab-sessions only narrows who can connect).
1000 = devuser (tab0-bridge, the picker, the operator); 961 = ab-gateway (nostr-gateway /spawn under [security].role_isolation).
